test.title: A second life for coffee grounds

paragraphs.text: Around the world, people drink billions of cups of coffee a day, and most of the used grounds end up in rubbish bins. In landfill sites, the grounds break down and release methane, a gas that traps far more heat than carbon dioxide.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Several small companies now collect grounds from cafés and turn them into useful products. One process dries the grounds and presses them into logs that can be burned in wood stoves. Another extracts the oil they contain, which is then used in soaps and cosmetics.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Gardeners have long spread coffee grounds on their soil, but researchers advise caution. A university trial found that adding large amounts of fresh grounds actually slowed the growth of several vegetables. Grounds that had first been composted for a few months, on the other hand, improved the soil.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: The main difficulty for collectors is transport. Wet grounds are heavy and begin to grow mould within days, so collection only makes sense where many cafés are close together. For now, the businesses operate almost entirely in city centres.
paragraphs.label: D

document.title: A second life for coffee grounds

items.quote: release methane, a gas that traps far more heat than carbon dioxide
items.prompt: Coffee grounds in landfill produce a gas that contributes to global warming.

explanation.en: “release methane, a gas that traps far more heat” — a gas that traps heat is one that contributes to warming → TRUE.
explanation.kk: «release methane, a gas that traps far more heat» — жылуды ұстайтын газ жаһандық жылынуды күшейтеді → TRUE.
explanation.ru: «release methane, a gas that traps far more heat» — газ, удерживающий тепло, и есть газ, усиливающий потепление → TRUE.

items.quote: presses them into logs that can be burned in wood stoves
items.prompt: Logs made from coffee grounds burn for longer than wood.

explanation.en: The text only says the logs can be burned in wood stoves. There is no comparison with how long wood burns → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Брикеттерді отын пешінде жағуға болатыны ғана айтылған. Ағашпен салыстырғанда қанша уақыт жанатыны айтылмаған → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: Сказано только, что брикеты можно жечь в дровяных печах. Сравнения со временем горения дров нет → NOT GIVEN.

items.quote: adding large amounts of fresh grounds actually slowed the growth of several vegetables
items.prompt: Fresh coffee grounds always help vegetables to grow.

explanation.en: “fresh grounds actually slowed the growth” — so “always help” contradicts the trial’s result → FALSE.
explanation.kk: «fresh grounds actually slowed the growth» — жаңа ұнтақ өсуді баяулатқан. «Always help» тәжірибе нәтижесіне қайшы → FALSE.
explanation.ru: «fresh grounds actually slowed the growth» — свежий жмых замедлил рост. «Always help» противоречит результату опыта → FALSE.

items.quote: Grounds that had first been composted for a few months, on the other hand, improved the soil
items.prompt: In the trial, composted grounds had a positive effect on the soil.

explanation.en: “Grounds that had first been composted … improved the soil”. “Had a positive effect” says the same thing in other words → TRUE.
explanation.kk: «Grounds that had first been composted … improved the soil» — компостқа айналған ұнтақ топырақты жақсартқан. «Had a positive effect» дәл осыны басқа сөзбен айтады → TRUE.
explanation.ru: «Grounds that had first been composted … improved the soil» — компостированный жмых улучшил почву. «Had a positive effect» говорит то же самое другими словами → TRUE.

items.quote: Wet grounds are heavy and begin to grow mould within days
items.prompt: Wet coffee grounds can be stored for several weeks without any problems.

explanation.en: “begin to grow mould within days” — mould appears in days, so weeks of trouble-free storage are not possible → FALSE.
explanation.kk: «begin to grow mould within days» — бірнеше күнде зең пайда болады, демек бірнеше апта сақтау мүмкін емес → FALSE.
explanation.ru: «begin to grow mould within days» — плесень появляется за несколько дней, значит, недели хранения без проблем невозможны → FALSE.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage? Write TRUE if the statement agrees with the information, FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, or NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.
